scientific_integrity: The general theorem is proved using vertex-transitivity and mixed cumulants; finite exact checks validate boundary cases and formulas but do not certify all finite graphs.
scientific_limitations: Only moments of order k with 2k<dist(b,t) are proved invariant; full-law invariance and sharpness at higher orders are not claimed. Historical priority remains subject to further independent review.
title: Distant forced extrema preserve low-order peak-count moments on vertex-transitive graphs
